title: Video skill: animation you can follow

scenes.text: Ask an AI to animate something, and it usually moves too fast. Everything happens at once, and nothing stays still long enough to read.
Here is the same animation, slowed down. One change at a time. Each step holds, so you can follow it.

This is the video skill, a free, open-source skill for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. You ask for a video. Your agent writes the script, records the voice, and animates every frame in code, in time with the narrator.
It makes three kinds of video. Explainers that draw how a system works. Walkthroughs of a real app, with a pointer that clicks as the narrator speaks. And motion loops for social posts.
Every video follows the classic principles of animation. Then the agent checks its own work. It looks at every frame, and it measures every pause.
Captions are included, in any language. No video editor needed. It's free, and the link is below.
